banter.role: playful non-speaking puppy and proud wrong-item fetcher
banter.funnyHabit: Brings the wrong everyday object first and wags proudly until the child helps spot the right one.

foils.momo: Drops a silly wrong prop at Momo's feet with a proud tail wag before fetching the real ball.
foils.peeko: Sniffs around the barn while Peeko hides in plain sight right beside him.

bannedBehaviours: Never growls, snaps, chases frighteningly, or barks in rapid loud runs
Never jumps toward the camera startlingly
